units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 10. The written conclusion on the results of the internal service inquiry is signed by the head of the state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters and the other participants in the inquiry, and is placed in the personnel file of the civil servant who was subject to the inquiry.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 48

units.locator: Chapter 12. Staffing of the civil service
units.text: Chapter 12. Staffing of the civil service
units.label: Chapter 12. Staffing of the civil service

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.label: Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 1. The civil service personnel complement of a state body shall be formed on the basis of the following principles:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 1) appointment of civil servants to civil service positions taking account of the results of their professional service activities;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 2) improvement of civil servants' professional level.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 2. Priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement shall be:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 1) training personnel for civil service and professional development of civil servants;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 2) supporting civil servants’ career advancement on a competitive basis; 3) rotation of civil servants;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 4) formation and effective use of the personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 5) assessment of civil servants' professional service activity results through attestation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 6) use of modern personnel technologies upon entry into and during civil service.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
units.text: 3. In accordance with federal legislation, regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow determine the civil service positions subject to rotation and regulate other matters concerning civil servant rotation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service
units.text: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service
units.label: Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service
units.text: 1. Personnel for civil service are trained in vocational education organizations and higher education organizations in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service
units.text: 2. A targeted education agreement financed from funds provided for by the City of Moscow law on the budget of the City of Moscow, between a state body and a citizen undertaking to perform civil service for a specified period after graduation, is concluded on a competitive basis in accordance with the procedure established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service
units.text: 3. Training of personnel for civil service is coordinated by the state service management body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant's professional development shall aim to maintain and improve their professional level and shall include further professional education and other professional development activities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant's professional development shall take place throughout their entire period of civil service.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 3. The grounds for sending a civil servant to participate in professional development activities are: 1) a decision of the employer’s representative;
units.label: Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 2) the results of the civil servant's attestation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 3) appointment of the civil servant to another civil service position in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 28 of this Law; 4) first appointment, by way of career advancement, to a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest or principal group of civil service positions, or to a position in the ‘specialists’ category of the highest group;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 5) a citizen's first entry into civil service.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 4. A civil servant’s professional development activities may be implemented: 1) through a state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs;
units.label: Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 2) within a state assignment in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 3) at the expense of the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, in an organization delivering further professional education programmes selected under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 5. A civil servant’s professional development activities may be carried out outside the territory of the Russian Federation on the basis of a state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ additional professional education.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 6. A civil servant's professional development activities shall take place with or without release from civil service duties.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 7. The employer's representative, educational organization, state body or other organization shall create conditions for the professional development of a civil servant participating in professional development activities.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 8. A civil servant's further professional education shall include professional retraining and advanced training.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
units.text: 9. A civil servant’s additional professional education is provided by organizations delivering additional professional programmes, including on the basis of a state educational certificate for a civil servant’s additional professional education.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
units.text: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
units.label: Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
units.text: 1. The state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities for the next year includes:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
units.text: 1) the state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ additional professional education; 2) the state order of the City of Moscow for other civil servants’ professional development activities.
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
units.text: 2. The state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities is drawn up by the state service management body on the basis of applications from state bodies, taking account of their functions and specialization, and the professional education associated with the civil service positions held in those bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
units.text: 3. The state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities, including its volume and structure, is approved by a law or other regulatory legal act of the City of Moscow, taking account of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.label: Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 1. To fill vacant civil service positions, a personnel reserve of the City of Moscow and personnel reserves of state bodies are formed from civil servants and citizens.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 2. The personnel reserve of the City of Moscow is formed by the state service management body to fill civil service positions in the highest, principal and leading groups, from civil servants and citizens included in the personnel reserves of state bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 3. A state body’s personnel reserve is formed by the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 4. Civil servants and citizens shall be included in a state body's personnel reserve with an indication of the group of civil service positions to which they may be appointed.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 5. Inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall take place:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 1) for citizens, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 2) for citizens, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 3) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 4) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 5) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement — on the basis of appraisal results in accordance with point 1 of part 16 of Article 37 of this Law, with the consent of those civil servants;
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 6) for civil servants dismissed because of a reduction of civil service positions in accordance with point 8_2 of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, or abolition of a state body in accordance with point 8_3 of part 1 of Article 37 of that Federal Law — by decision of the employer’s representative of the state body reducing positions or the state body receiving the functions of the abolished body, with those civil servants’ consent; 7) for civil servants dismissed on the grounds provided for by part 1 of Article 39 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, with those civil servants’ consent;
units.label: Point 6 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 8) for civil servants dismissed because transfer under points 3-5, 9 and 12-14 of part 5 of Article 25 of this Law is impossible owing to the absence of another civil service position, or because they refuse transfer to another position under Article 25 of this Law — by decision of the employer’s representative with those civil servants’ consent.
units.label: Point 8 Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 6. Civil servants are included in a state body’s personnel reserve in accordance with points 6-8 of part 5 of this Article to fill civil service positions in the same group as their last civil service position.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 7. A competition for inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall be conducted by that body's competition commission.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 8. Inclusion of a civil servant or citizen in the personnel reserve of the City of Moscow is formalized by a legal act of the state service management body; inclusion in a state body’s personnel reserve is formalized by a legal act of that state body.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 9. A civil servant or citizen in the personnel reserve shall be appointed to a vacant civil service position with their consent by decision of the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
units.text: 10. The regulation on the civil service personnel reserve, establishing the procedure for forming and working with the personnel reserve of the City of Moscow and state bodies’ personnel reserves, is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 53

units.locator: Chapter 13. Financing of the civil service. Development of the civil service
units.text: Chapter 13. Financing of the civil service. Development of the civil service
units.label: Chapter 13. Financing of the civil service. Development of the civil service

units.locator: Article 54. Financing of the civil service
units.text: Article 54. Financing of the civil service
units.label: Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Financing of the civil service
units.text: Civil ‘service is financed from the budget of the City of Moscow in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Art. 54 · text

units.locator: Article 55. Development of the civil service
units.text: Article 55. Development of the civil service
units.label: Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Development of the civil service
units.text: 2. Experiments applying new approaches to the organization of civil service and support for civil servants’ activities (hereinafter referred to as experiments) may be conducted in a state body, an autonomous structural subdivision of that body, or several state bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Development of the civil service
units.text: 3. The procedure for organizing experiments aimed at developing the civil service and the requirements for conducting them are established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, taking account of the conditions provided for by part 4 of Article 66 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 55

units.locator: Chapter 14. Administration of the state service
units.text: Chapter 14. Administration of the state service
units.label: Chapter 14. Administration of the state service

units.locator: Article 56. State service management body
units.text: Article 56. State service management body
units.label: Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. State service management body
units.text: 1. Overall direction and coordination of the civil service of the City of Moscow are exercised by the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 56
